title: The Soul and Body
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The soul and body teaches that human beings are embodied souls created by God for life before Him. The body is not worthless, and the soul is not independent of God; the whole person belongs to the Creator.
summary: The soul and body teaches that human beings are embodied souls created by God for life before Him. The body is not worthless, and the soul is not independent of God; the whole person belongs to the Creator.
christFocus: Jesus Christ took on a real human body and soul to redeem whole persons. His bodily resurrection shows that God’s final purpose is not escape from the body, but resurrection life and complete restoration.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture presents human beings as whole persons before God. God formed man from the dust and gave him breath. Humanity is not merely a body, and not merely a spirit trapped in a body; people are embodied souls made for God.

Sin affects the whole person. Bodies suffer weakness, sickness, pain, temptation, and death. The inner life is also affected by desire, fear, guilt, shame, and unbelief. Redemption must therefore be more than outward improvement.

The incarnation honors human embodiment. The Son of God truly took flesh, suffered bodily, died, and rose bodily. The resurrection of Christ guarantees that God’s plan includes the redemption of the body.

Believers therefore should not despise the body or worship the body. The whole person belongs to God and must be stewarded for His glory while awaiting final resurrection.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people treat the body as everything, while others treat it as worthless. Scripture corrects both errors. Bodies matter because God made them, Christ took flesh, and believers await bodily redemption.

This doctrine brings hope to those living with disability, chronic pain, weakness, aging, illness, or trauma. The body may groan now, but Christ’s resurrection promises that God will redeem His people completely.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Offer your whole self to God. Do not use your body for sin or despise it because of weakness. Care for your body wisely, guard your inner life faithfully, and set your hope on Christ, who redeems both soul and body and will raise His people in glory.
